All 12 tests pass and the demo still prints `true`. Here's what changed and why each decision was made:

**`DirectedGraph`**
- Constructor is now `private` — only `Builder.build()` can produce an instance, so post-construction mutation is impossible by design.
- At build time the adjacency list is deep-copied and every inner list is wrapped with `Collections.unmodifiableList`. Any attempt to call `add()` on a neighbor list will throw `UnsupportedOperationException` at runtime.
- `addEdge` is removed from `DirectedGraph` — it no longer exists as a surface for mutation.
- `DirectedGraph.Builder` is the sole mutable accumulator; it returns `this` for chaining, matching the existing fluent style.

**`DetectCycle`** — switched to `DirectedGraph.builder(4).addEdge(...).build()`.

**`GraphBuilder` (test)** — now delegates to `DirectedGraph.Builder` internally, so the test API (`withVertices / edge / build`) is unchanged and the fixture constants in `CycleDetectorTest` required no edits.
